title: Herb Cashew Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry made with tender cashews, herbal flavors, and light vegetables.

ingredients.name: Tender vegetables (such as bell peppers or carrots)
Light oil (such as vegetable or peanut oil)

instructions: Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the tender vegetables and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add the cashews and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the herbs and soy sauce, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
